title: Progressive enhancement
description: Build a native form that still reaches a safe local destination without JavaScript, then add an optional status-enhancing submit handler.
objectives: Provide a usable no-JavaScript form submission destination
Enhance with a progressive status message, not fabricated persistence
Avoid accidental suppression of native constraint validation
Check the enabled and disabled JavaScript paths in a real browser
rubric: I created a native form with usable no-script navigation.
I added an optional, truthful live-region preview while preserving browser validation.
I tested both JavaScript-enabled and JavaScript-disabled paths.
